name: dev-workflow-standard
description: CTO/orchestrator development standard: diagnose demands, consolidate scope, require specs before tasks, delegate spec creation to sdd-spec-factory and implementation to dev-implementation-standard, trigger UI/UX and security validation, and review PRs against specs, task and acceptance criteria. Does not implement product code directly.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate diagnosis, scope, spec/implementation delegation, and PR review.
interface.longDescription: Dev Workflow Standard makes Codex the CTO/orchestrator for software delivery: receive a demand, diagnose, ask critical questions, consolidate scope, require specs before tasks, delegate spec creation to sdd-spec-factory and implementation to dev-implementation-standard, trigger ui-ux-standard when there is UI and security-standard when sensitive surfaces are touched, then review PRs against specs, task and acceptance criteria and approve or request rework. It never writes product code directly.
defaultPrompt: Use Dev Workflow Standard to diagnose this demand and consolidate scope.
Use Dev Workflow Standard to require specs and delegate them to sdd-spec-factory.
Use Dev Workflow Standard to delegate this approved task to dev-implementation-standard.
Use Dev Workflow Standard to review this PR against the specs, task and acceptance criteria.
